import pandas as pd

# Let's inspect facts and compute key metrics
years_list = ['2023-09-30', '2024-09-28', '2025-09-27', '2026-09-26']

data = {}
for metric, info in facts.items():
    data[metric] = [info['values'].get(y) for y in years_list]

df_calc = pd.DataFrame(data, index=years_list)
print("Raw DataFrame:")
print(df_calc[['revenue', 'net_income', 'operating_cash_flow', 'capex', 'accounts_receivable', 'inventory']])

# Calculate metrics
rev = df_calc['revenue']
ni = df_calc['net_income']
cfo = df_calc['operating_cash_flow']
capex = df_calc['capex']
fcf = cfo - capex
gp = df_calc['gross_profit']
oi = df_calc['operating_income']
ta = df_calc['total_assets']
eq = df_calc['stockholders_equity']

gross_margin = gp / rev
operating_margin = oi / rev
net_margin = ni / rev
fcf_margin = fcf / rev
cfo_to_ni = cfo / ni
asset_turnover = rev / ta
equity_multiplier = ta / eq
roe = net_margin * asset_turnover * equity_multiplier

metrics_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'Revenue ($B)': rev / 1e9,
    'Net Income ($B)': ni / 1e9,
    'CFO ($B)': cfo / 1e9,
    'FCF ($B)': fcf / 1e9,
    'CFO / Net Income': cfo_to_ni,
    'Gross Margin (%)': gross_margin * 100,
    'Operating Margin (%)': operating_margin * 100,
    'Net Margin (%)': net_margin * 100,
    'ROE (%)': roe * 100
}, index=['FY23', 'FY24', 'FY25', 'FY26'])

print("\nComputed Metrics:")
print(metrics_df.round(2))

# Growth rates
rev_growth = rev.pct_change() * 100
ni_growth = ni.pct_change() * 100
cfo_growth = cfo.pct_change() * 100
print("\nYoY Growth (%):")
growth_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'Revenue Growth %': rev_growth,
    'Net Income Growth %': ni_growth,
    'CFO Growth %': cfo_growth
}, index=['FY23', 'FY24', 'FY25', 'FY26'])
print(growth_df.round(2))
